title: Judy-Lynn del Rey: The Galaxy Gal
original_title: Judy-Lynn del Rey: The Galaxy Gal
overview: The story of a woman with dwarfism who revolutionized the world of science fiction by editing and publishing books from sci-fi writers such as Arthur C. Clarke, Isaac Asimov, Philip K. Dick and George Lucas' "Star Wars" in novel form. See how science fiction narratives, through their speculative and imaginative nature, offer a more inclusive and equitable lens through which to redefine disability.
